task: Automate Putaway and Replenishment transfers from Receiving to Storage/Picking zones. Route items by dimension and demand.
checklist: Transfer task is auto-created once inbound receiving is completed
Oversized items are routed to Bulk Storage; standard items to Active Picking
Handheld device shows putaway tasks prioritized by urgency
Negative: inbound not completed -> no transfer task is created
Edge: item with missing dimensions -> routed to fallback zone and flagged, NOT silently dropped
Edge: destination zone is full -> task is queued/blocked with a clear status, not lost
Rollback: if putaway confirmation fails mid-way, stock quantities stay consistent (no double-count)
Concurrency: two workers scan the same LPN -> only one transfer succeeds
Audit: every transfer logs source zone, destination zone, worker and timestamp
